name: app-hand-held-phone-on-perforated-blue-wall
title: Hand holding a phone against a perforated cobalt panel
whatItIs: A photographic mockup: a hand holds a phone with an orange frame in front of a cobalt perforated metal wall. The screen shows a full-bleed ocean photo with a serif headline about sailing.
whatItMeans: Bold, tactile and aspirational; the saturated blue-orange complement gives an instant editorial punch.
techniques: Choose a real-world textured background in the app's brand colour for a stage.
Use a complementary accent (orange phone case) to separate the device from the background.
Let a real hand hold the device to add scale and human presence.
Repeat the wall's dot pattern as a pattern language for the brand.

vocabulary.definition: A device photographed being held, for realism.
Using opposite colours (blue/orange) so both stand out.
A surface pattern of regular holes.
The main image chosen to sell a project.
